title: Lab Centrifuge Stainless Steel 316L Centritec Cell 8 - IPP# 239307
card_title: Lab Centrifuge Stainless Steel 316L Centritec Cell 8
additional_info: Centritec Cell 8 single use insert centrifuge This type of flow centrifuge is for harvesting mammalian and insect cells in a single use insert. The system offers these advantages Single use, rapid changeover disposable, Precise servo drive system that minimizes vibration, User friendly, and low maintenance. Cells are pumped peristaltically from the bio reactor to the cell 8, Live cells can be recycled to the reactor, separation occurs in a gamma irritated disposable bladder and tubing system (Separation Insert) The process is three steps separation, isolation, and discharge. An inflatable barrier segregates cell rich material for the superannuant Min/Max Temp=2 -150 degrees C. (this machine has been modified with switches ,plc, and others to control temperature at an exact setpoint) Separation chamber volume 200 ml. Through put 6-120 L/Hr. Width 32.23 ", depth 46.86 ", height 67.99" Weight 640 kg.
